title: Section K: Identity, Auth & Session Verification
description: Validates JWT token signature lifecycle, granular RBAC role authorization, cryptographic multi-tenant context isolation, and instant session revocation blacklists.

assertions.name: JWT_Signature_Lifecycle_And_Rotation
assertions.message: Cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature verified and refresh token rotated successfully.

assertions.name: Granular_RBAC_Role_Authorization
assertions.message: RBAC authorization enforced: Allowed read/write, strictly denied delete/admin for DOCUMENT_EDITOR.

assertions.name: MultiTenant_Cryptographic_Context_Isolation
assertions.message: Tenant isolation verified: Hard tenant ID boundary prevented cross-tenant data leakage.

assertions.name: Instant_Session_Revocation_Blacklist
assertions.message: Instant session revocation blacklisted token immediately, blocking all subsequent API calls.
